related_questions.question: How long should I wait before testing for COVID after exposure?

text_blocks.snippet: If you've been exposed to COVID-19, test immediately if you have symptoms. If you don't have symptoms, wait at least 5 full days after exposure before testing. If your initial test is negative, repeat the test according to the instructions for your specific test. For antigen tests, repeat testing at least twice over three days if symptomatic and at least three times over five days if asymptomatic, according to the FDA.

related_questions.question: Can you test for COVID too late?
